answer: Because each prism escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the walnut ledger records every share and the ivory audit exposes the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 44 aliases means 44 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
